parameters.content:
## Jina Reader callable workflow
Receives one URL from another workflow, normalizes it with string-only logic, calls the free Jina Reader endpoint, and returns normalized markdown content.

Reader URL pattern mirrors the working Brave search workflow:
`https://r.jina.ai/${url}`

No credentials are required for this first slice. Keep volume conservative on the free endpoint.
